description: React component for displaying a badge with customization info related to a specific chart in Apache Superset. It shows the count of customizations and provides a tooltip with details.

methods.name: getCustomizationDataset
methods.description: Extracts dataset ID from a customization item.

methods.name: makeSelectChartDataset
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector to get the dataset ID for a chart.

methods.name: makeSelectChartFormData
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector to get the latest query form data for a chart.
